## Description {#details}

Generic strongly-typed wrapper for explicit type conversion.

<SectionUser title="Since">
3.2.0
</SectionUser>

The <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/to-t">to&#95;t</Link></code> template provides a public, strongly-typed wrapper for any type <code>T</code>, enabling explicit conversion of dynamic values and expressions to a type recognised by the µTest++ comparators and reporting mechanisms.

This wrapper inherits from <code><Link to="/docs/api/structs/micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus/type-traits/value">type&#95;traits::value</Link>&lt;T&gt;</code>, ensuring that the encapsulated value is treated as the specified type within the framework. It is particularly useful for enhancing type safety and clarity in test expressions, especially when working with user-defined or less common types.


<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing>

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">MyType obj;</Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight><Highlight kind="keyword">auto</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal"> wrapped = <Link to="/docs/api/groups/micro-test-plus-literals/#gaad9720f2d1e443d77cdfd1eb1151e924">to&#95;t&lt;MyType&gt;</Link>&#123;obj&#125;; </Highlight><Highlight kind="comment">// Explicitly treat obj as MyType for</Highlight><Highlight kind="normal"></Highlight></CodeLine>
<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">test comparison</Highlight></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>

This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
